answer: NovaOps does not allow employees to use a personal laptop for work, except for a five-business-day IT continuity exception when a managed laptop is being repaired or replaced and the employee has no working device. IT must approve and log the exception before the employee uses a personal machine, even for those five days. Personal laptops are otherwise prohibited for work use according to the equipment policy effective 2026-06-01​[documents/policies/equipment_policy.md § Personal laptops]​.

During the five-business-day IT continuity exception, IT must approve and log the use of a personal laptop before you can use it, even for those five days. You cannot just go ahead without their approval and logging as required by the equipment policy effective 2026-06-01​[documents/policies/equipment_policy.md § Personal laptops]​.
The equipment policy, including the rule on personal laptops, is owned by IT, as stated in the policy document effective 2026-06-01​[documents/policies/equipment_policy.md § (whole document)]​.

1. Personal laptops are prohibited for work use except for a five-business-day IT continuity exception when a managed laptop is being repaired or replaced and the employee has no working device​[documents/policies/equipment_policy.md § Personal laptops]​.
2. IT must approve and log the exception before the employee uses a personal machine, even for those five days​[documents/policies/equipment_policy.md § Personal laptops]​.
